_comment: UNVERIFIED SEED DATA. domain -> normalized category. issuer_overrides encode the known disputes (e.g. Amex does not treat Instacart as a US supermarket). confidence: high|medium|low.

starbucks.com.note: reloads may code as dining, gift cards may not

instacart.com.note: third-party delivery; most issuers do NOT code this as a supermarket

target.com.note: classic trap: Target does NOT code as groceries on any major issuer

amazon.com.note: most cards have no online-retail bonus; expect the 2% catch-all to win

booking.com.note: Online travel agency, not a direct booking. Issuers that pay elevated rates only on 'booked direct' travel pay base rate here.

expedia.com.note: Online travel agency, not a direct booking. Issuers that pay elevated rates only on 'booked direct' travel pay base rate here.

airbnb.com.note: Online travel agency, not a direct booking. Issuers that pay elevated rates only on 'booked direct' travel pay base rate here.

netflix.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: no JSON-LD and no og:type on any surface, so only real payment machinery can tell the browse grid from the payment step

hulu.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: same signal shape as netflix.com -- price only, nothing structural

youtube.com.note: only YouTube Premium/TV charges code as streaming

chargepoint.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: marketing home renders a price, so listing it mounts the dock there. Charging itself is paid at the charger; the web surface is account top-up

electrifyamerica.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: marketing home is signal-free, so listing costs nothing. Web surface is Pass+ plan signup

evgo.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: marketing home is signal-free. Web surface is plan signup

t-mobile.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: already showed via cart link + price, but ranked as everything else. Handset purchases here may code as retail rather than telecom

verizon.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: og:type article, no JSON-LD, price only. Same handset-vs-bill ambiguity as t-mobile.com

xfinity.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: no JSON-LD, no controls, price only

att.com.note: UNMEASURED: category assigned from the brand, signals not read off the live site

spectrum.com.note: UNMEASURED: category assigned from the brand, signals not read off the live site

coned.com.note: measured 2026-09-09: public site is entirely signal-free, so the dock only appears once a bill page renders an amount due. Listed as the worked example -- see README on why a table cannot cover US utilities

hotels.com.note: Online travel agency, not a direct booking. Issuers paying elevated rates only on 'booked direct' travel pay base rate here.
